write through pointer p into command buffer
parse formatted input from command buffer into bounds fields

convert floating-point value to integer size

states.claim: image is an acquired Image object; OpenBlob establishes an open blob on it, and it is destroyed on failure paths before return.
input_filename is established as a unique symbolic link resource by AcquireUniqueSymbolicLink and is later relinquished.
p is initialized to point to the command buffer and is reset to command after each token is terminated.
read_info is a cloned ImageInfo; its filename is replaced with a unique filename resource that is later relinquished, and read_info is destroyed.
density and options are acquired strings that are destroyed after use.
image is destroyed before read_info is cloned and before the delegate command is run.
image is reassigned from ReadImage; if NULL, a reader exception is thrown.
If image->magick is BMP, ConsolidateCMYKImages may produce cmyk_image; when non-NULL, the original image list is destroyed and image is replaced by cmyk_image.
The image list is traversed via SyncNextImageInList; image is advanced to next_image while next_image is non-NULL.

values.claim: p is initialized to command and advanced by one byte per stored character; the buffer is bounded by MagickPathExtent, and the loop continues only while (p-command) < MagickPathExtent-1, so p-command is the current byte count in command.
After a delimiter or full buffer, *p is set to '\0' and p is reset to command, so command is NUL-terminated before string parsing.
count is assigned the number of successfully scanned fields from sscanf into bounds.x1, bounds.y1, bounds.x2, bounds.y2; only count == 4 is treated as a complete box.
width is computed as (size_t)CastDoubleToLong(floor(bounds.x2-bounds.x1+0.5)), converting the floating-point box width to size_t.
height is computed as (size_t)CastDoubleToLong(floor(bounds.y2-bounds.y1+0.5)), converting the floating-point box height to size_t.
page.width is updated to width only when width is greater than the current page.width.
page.height is updated to height only when height is greater than the current page.height.
If page.width or page.height is zero, page is parsed from PSPageGeometry; if image_info->page is non-NULL, page is parsed from image_info->page.
page.width and page.height are rescaled by image resolution divided by delta, using floor(x+0.5) and cast to size_t.
geometry is formatted as "%.20gx%.20g" from page.width and page.height cast to double.
options is formatted as "-g%.20gx%.20g " from page.width and page.height cast to double.
density is formatted as "%gx%g" from image->resolution.x and image->resolution.y.
command is formatted with GetDelegateCommands(delegate_info) and arguments including antialias-derived 4 or 1, density, options, read_info->filename, and input_filename.

values.claim: When image_info->ping is true, image->magick_columns, image->magick_rows, image->columns, and image->rows are multiplied by image->resolution.x/2.0 or image->resolution.y/2.0.

executions.claim: Loop continues while ReadBlobByte returns non-EOF; if image_info->page is non-NULL, the loop body skips all parsing and continues to the next byte.
After appending c to command, the loop continues without parsing unless c is '/' or '\n' or the command buffer is full (p-command >= MagickPathExtent-1).
count is set to the number of successfully scanned CropBox or MediaBox values; if count != 4, the loop continues without updating page dimensions.

executions.claim: When count == 4, width and height are computed from bounds and page.width/page.height are updated to the maximum of their current values and width/height.
After the read loop, if page.width or page.height is zero, page is set from PSPageGeometry; if image_info->page is non-NULL, page is set from image_info->page.
delegate_info is selected based on image_info->monochrome and cmyk; if NULL, the function destroys image and returns NULL.
After delegate selection, if page.width or page.height is zero, page is set from PSPageGeometry; if image_info->page is non-NULL, page is set from image_info->page.
page.width and page.height are scaled by image resolution divided by delta, then used to format options.
If read_info->number_scenes != 0, options is overwritten with page-range arguments and number_scenes is reset to 0.
If ReadImage returns NULL, ThrowReaderException is invoked.
If image->magick is "BMP", ConsolidateCMYKImages is called; if it returns non-NULL, image is replaced by cmyk_image.
The do-while loop iterates over the image list until next_image is NULL.
